genres.label: Metal
genres.sonic_definition: Riff-centered amplified music characterized by strongly distorted timbres, pronounced rhythmic weight, and performance vocabularies developed within Metal.

genres.label: Rock
genres.sonic_definition: Amplified band music centered on rhythmic groove, a pronounced backbeat, and recurring guitar, bass, drum, and vocal song structures developed within Rock.

genres.label: Metalcore
genres.sonic_definition: Heavy music combining Metal riff vocabulary with Hardcore-derived rhythmic structures, transitions, and breakdown-centered arrangements.

genres.label: Deathcore
genres.sonic_definition: Heavy music combining Death Metal riffing and extreme-vocal vocabulary with breakdown-centered Core arrangements.

genres.label: Thall
genres.sonic_definition: Heavy music built around palm-muted low-register riff pulses, syncopated metric displacement, and polyrhythmic groove layering as defining rhythmic vocabulary, developed within Thall.

genres.label: Hardcore
genres.sonic_definition: Punk-derived amplified music built around velocity, brevity, and beat-driven or breakdown-centered rhythmic structures developed within Hardcore.

genres.label: Punk
genres.sonic_definition: High-energy amplified music built on tempo, downstroke guitar, direct vocal delivery, and anti-virtuosic brevity developed within Punk.

genres.label: Grunge
genres.sonic_definition: Rock combining heavy distorted guitar riffs, loud-quiet dynamic contrast, and introspective songwriting vocabularies developed within Grunge.

genres.label: Nu Metal
genres.sonic_definition: Metal combining down-tuned groove riffing with influences from Hip-Hop, Alternative Rock, and electronic production developed within Nu Metal.

genres.label: Emoviolence
genres.sonic_definition: Extreme music fusing Screamo-derived emotion and dissonance with Grindcore blast velocity and brevity, developed within Emoviolence.

genres.label: Jazz
genres.sonic_definition: Improvised music built on swing rhythm, blues-based harmony, and interactive ensemble improvisation, using the instrumental and vocal vocabularies developed within the Jazz tradition.

genres.label: Traditional Pop
genres.sonic_definition: Mid-20th-century popular vocal music built on standard song form (the American Songbook), sung delivery, and orchestral or small-combo accompaniment, developed before and alongside Rock.

genres.label: Electronic
genres.sonic_definition: Music built primarily on electronically generated or sampled timbres, sequenced or programmed rhythm, and studio-as-instrument production, developed within Electronic music.

genres.label: R&B
genres.sonic_definition: Vocal-centered popular music built on gospel- and blues-derived singing, groove-based rhythm, and expressive melisma, developed within the Rhythm and Blues tradition.

genres.label: Hip-Hop
genres.sonic_definition: Vocal-centered music built on rapped or chanted delivery over looped, sampled, or programmed rhythm, developed within the Hip-Hop tradition.

genres.label: Screamo
genres.sonic_definition: Hardcore-derived music built on frantic dynamic contrast between quiet melodic passages and explosive screamed vocals, dissonant guitars, and chaotic arrangements developed within Screamo.

genres.label: Emocore
genres.sonic_definition: Hardcore punk emphasizing confessional, emotionally intense vocals and melodic guitar work within concise song forms, developed within emotional hardcore (Emocore).

types.label: Heavy
types.sonic_definition: Traditional Metal built around forceful guitar riffs, clear song forms, and predominantly melodic lead work and vocals.

types.label: Death
types.sonic_definition: Metal using heavily distorted low-register riffing, extreme vocals, forceful percussion, and Death Metal rhythmic and harmonic vocabularies.

types.label: Doom
types.sonic_definition: Metal emphasizing slow or weighty pacing, sustained heavy riffs, and an oppressive or mournful harmonic character.

types.label: Black
types.sonic_definition: Metal using Black Metal riffing, tremolo-centered textures, characteristic extreme vocals, and its established rhythmic and harmonic vocabulary.

types.label: Thrash
types.sonic_definition: Metal emphasizing rapid palm-muted riffing, aggressive rhythmic attack, and tightly articulated high-energy arrangements.

types.label: Power
types.sonic_definition: Metal emphasizing melodic lead work, driving rhythms, harmonized guitars, and expansive predominantly clean-vocal arrangements.

types.label: Speed
types.sonic_definition: Metal organized around sustained fast tempos and rapid riff articulation derived from early fast Heavy Metal.

types.label: Gothic
types.sonic_definition: Metal using dark harmonic color, dramatic contrast, and established Gothic Metal vocal and arrangement vocabularies.

types.label: Sludge
types.sonic_definition: Metal using abrasive low-register riffing, thick distorted timbres, and rhythmically forceful Sludge vocabulary.

types.label: Industrial
types.sonic_definition: Metal structured around mechanical repetition, machine-like rhythm, and electronically processed or industrialized timbres.

types.label: Groove
types.sonic_definition: Metal emphasizing syncopated mid-tempo riff cycles, strong downbeat weight, and groove-centered rhythmic repetition.

types.label: Hard
types.sonic_definition: Rock emphasizing heavy guitar distortion, forceful drumming, and riff-driven arrangements while retaining Rock song vocabulary.

types.label: Alt.
types.sonic_definition: Rock using the contrasting timbres, dynamics, and songwriting vocabularies established by Alternative Rock.

types.label: Gothic
types.sonic_definition: Rock using dark post-punk-derived bass, guitar, vocal, and atmospheric vocabularies established by Gothic Rock.

types.label: Post
types.sonic_definition: Metal that audibly moves beyond conventional Metal song forms through texture, development, and structural abstraction.

types.label: Post
types.sonic_definition: Rock that audibly moves beyond conventional Rock song forms through texture, development, and structural abstraction.

types.label: Post
types.sonic_definition: Hardcore that audibly moves beyond conventional Hardcore song forms through texture, development, and structural abstraction.

types.label: Vocal
types.sonic_definition: Jazz centered on the vocal as the lead improvising voice, with jazz phrasing, diction, and repertoire.

types.label: Swing
types.sonic_definition: Jazz of the swing tradition built on a propulsive shuffle rhythm and arranged ensemble writing.

types.label: Big Band
types.sonic_definition: Jazz for a large orchestrated ensemble of reeds, brass, and rhythm, emphasizing arranged sections interleaved with solos.

types.label: Soul
types.sonic_definition: Jazz built on bluesy grooves, repeating vamps, and gospel- and blues-derived vocabulary.

types.label: House
types.sonic_definition: Electronic built on a four-on-the-floor kick, swung hi-hats, and repeating bass-and-riff grooves developed within House.

types.label: Techno
types.sonic_definition: Electronic built on machine-driven repetition, stark synthetic timbres, and a relentless groove developed within Techno.

types.label: IDM
types.sonic_definition: Electronic emphasizing intricate programmed rhythm, digital DSP, and headphone-oriented detail over dancefloor function.

types.label: Darkwave
types.sonic_definition: Electronic using cold synth pads, deep bass, drum-machine rhythm, and a melancholic post-punk atmosphere.

types.label: Synthpop
types.sonic_definition: Electronic built on song form, prominent synthesizer hooks, and pop vocal delivery.

types.label: Rock
types.sonic_definition: Electronic fusing sequenced rhythm and synthetic timbres with rock instrumentation, riffing, or vocal attack.

types.label: Alternative
types.sonic_definition: R&B using atmospheric production, electronic and synthesized timbres, introspective songwriting, and the vocal and arrangement vocabularies established by Alternative R&B.

types.label: Boom Bap
types.sonic_definition: Hip-Hop built on sampled acoustic-drum breaks and gritty mid-tempo loops with an MC-centered vocal, characteristic of 1990s East Coast and underground production.

types.label: G-Funk
types.sonic_definition: Hip-Hop built on high synthesizer lead lines, funk-derived samples, and a laid-back West Coast groove developed within G-Funk.

types.label: Trap
types.sonic_definition: Hip-Hop built on rapid programmed hi-hat patterns, deep 808 bass, and dark synthetic production developed within Trap.

types.label: Breakcore
types.sonic_definition: Electronic built on extreme high-tempo editing of sampled breakbeats, abrupt rhythmic rupture, and dense clipped percussive collage.

traits.label: Technical
traits.sonic_definition: Prominent compositional and performance complexity requiring unusually precise or advanced execution.

traits.label: Melodic
traits.sonic_definition: Melodic development is a defining structural focus rather than an incidental element.

traits.label: Blackened
traits.sonic_definition: Audible use of Black Metal riffing, texture, vocal, or harmonic characteristics without classification as the Black Type.

traits.label: Atmospheric
traits.sonic_definition: Sustained texture, space, layering, and ambience are defining compositional elements.

traits.label: Raw
traits.sonic_definition: Deliberately unpolished timbre and production are defining parts of the audible result.

traits.label: Symphonic
traits.sonic_definition: Orchestral arrangement, instrumentation, or orchestration techniques are defining structural elements.

traits.label: Brutal
traits.sonic_definition: Extreme density, percussive force, low-register riffing, and aggressive articulation are defining characteristics.

traits.label: Progressive
traits.sonic_definition: Extended development, structural variation, metric complexity, or nonstandard form is a defining compositional focus.

traits.label: Stoner
traits.sonic_definition: Fuzz-heavy timbre, repetitive groove, and psychedelic-derived riff development shape the Doom Metal sound.

traits.label: Funeral
traits.sonic_definition: Extremely slow dirge-like pacing, sustained weight, and expansive mournful atmosphere shape the Doom Metal sound.

traits.label: Post
traits.sonic_definition: The music audibly moves beyond the base Genre's conventional song forms through texture, development, and structural abstraction.

traits.label: Folk
traits.sonic_definition: Traditional or vernacular melodic, rhythmic, instrumental, or arrangement vocabularies materially shape the sound.

traits.label: Viking
traits.sonic_definition: A maintainer-curated Metal sound defined by its characteristic melodic, rhythmic, vocal, and arrangement vocabulary; themes or artist origin alone do not qualify.

traits.label: Pirate
traits.sonic_definition: A maintainer-curated Metal sound defined by characteristic folk-derived melody, rhythm, vocal phrasing, and arrangement; themes or imagery alone do not qualify.

traits.label: Neoclassical
traits.sonic_definition: Classical harmonic language, melodic construction, formal devices, and instrumental techniques materially shape the Metal sound.

traits.label: Crossover
traits.sonic_definition: Hardcore-derived rhythm, vocal delivery, and arrangement materially shape the Thrash Metal sound.

traits.label: Electronic
traits.sonic_definition: Synthesized timbres, electronic instrumentation, programmed or sequenced rhythm, and production techniques developed within Electronic music materially shape the sound.

traits.label: Depressive
traits.sonic_definition: Slow-to-mid tempos, minor-key tremolo repetition held well past resolution, thin trebly production, and strained anguished vocal delivery shape the Black Metal sound.
